stories.title: Sources: Baylor fires Aranda day after 1st loss to KU since '07
stories.summary: Baylor has fired head coach Dave Aranda after six-plus seasons.

stories.title: Sources: Simmons told to leave Chiefs team meeting by Reid, Mahomes
stories.summary: Josh Simmons was kicked out of a team meeting by Chiefs coach Andy Reid and QB Patrick Mahomes, but the OT later apologized, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Sources: Colts face big decisions on star players as trade deadline looms
stories.summary: The Colts are expected to field trade inquiries on some of their star players, including Jonathan Taylor, DeForest Buckner and Quenton Nelson.

stories.title: Pistons lose $200M man Duren for at least two weeks with hamstring strain
stories.summary: Pistons center Jalen Duren, who signed a five-year extension earlier this month, will be out at least two weeks with a right hamstring strain.

stories.title: NFL, NFLPA reviewing how QB Hurts' blood clot diagnosis was handled
stories.summary: The NFL and NFL Players Association are working together to review the handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis.
